comparison.objective: Choose fitting tweezers and peel protective film from a display module while holding its carrier.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool selection, constrained tab grasping, peel-force control, and carrier stabilization.
comparison.success_condition: Film fully detached and set aside, carrier excursion limited, both tweezers returned correctly, objects still, and hands clear.
comparison.reason: Tests constrained tool-mediated peeling and tool return, not aperture-based material separation.
